name: Interval Gap
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C$, let $g(C)=\max(\{d_H(a,b)-1:a,b\in C,\ a\neq b,\ C\cap[a,b]=\{a,b\}\}\cup\{0\})$, where $[a,b]$ is the ambient cube interval.
normalization: Singletons have value zero. The invariant uses the displayed cube embedding and is unchanged by cube symmetries and constant-coordinate extensions.
